title: Law to require accessible swings in city playgrounds
summary: This bill would require the Department of Parks and Recreation to install at least two accessible swings for children ages 2 to 12 with disabilities in half of its playgrounds by December 31, 2033 and in all playgrounds by December 31, 2036. New or newly acquired playgrounds would also need accessible swings within set timeframes. Where installation is infeasible due to space constraints, the department must notify the Council Speaker and local Council member in writing, explaining why.
